about: Publication policy for the live site. Author-controlled: see docs/DECISIONS.md. Changing a value here changes what search engines may index.
indexDraftPages_note: While the ingested manuscript is a draft, pages built from it (reader, references, methods, evaluation, orientations, safety) carry <meta name="robots" content="noindex">. They stay reachable by link and in the site's own search. Set to true only if the authors approve indexing of draft text. noindex is not access control: anything deployed is public.
